press_references.value: Arc Announces $160 Million Deal With Curtin Maritime for Eight Hybrid-Electric Tugboats

partnership_announcements.description: Arc announced a $160 million contract with Curtin Maritime to deliver eight hybrid-electric ship-assist tugboats, with vessel construction in collaboration with Snow & Co shipyard. The deal, touted as the largest commercial deployment of electric workboats to date, includes delivery of the first four tugs by end of 2027 and is privately funded.

research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Arc Boats is engaged in developing watercraft featuring an adjustable tower assembly, as described in a design where a support structure moves between positions in response to actuation. They are also working on watercraft with a liquid cooled display, which maintains high brightness, and on electric boats with a battery system that can be repositioned within the hull to adjust the center of gravity. These efforts focus on structural adaptability, display cooling, and battery placement.
